summary: Post-market view (2026-10-15 late-session snapshot): the composite risk score reads 58.54 with the level at caution and regime risk_on, 0.77 below the previous published layer of 2026-10-14 at 59.31. Against the same-calendar-day morning generation of 61.38 (high_risk) the score is 2.84 lower and the level steps back from high_risk to caution, but the recorded trend_1d of -2.84 is the difference between two generations on the same calendar day, not a day-over-day move. The tape is not a broad de-rating but a split inside technology: of 22 sector and theme rows 12 rose and 10 fell, with a mean move of 0.4477; memory fell 3.9231, semiconductor_equipment fell 2.7256 and networking fell 2.3462, while quantum_computing rose 4.5002, fintech rose 3.916, digital_advertising rose 3.5122 and ai_software rose 2.8507; the SPY proxy rose 0.3002, IWM rose 1.2898 and XLY rose 1.7489 against XLP at 0.7901. The macro legs are clearly lagged: the 10-year rates are dated 2026-10-13, credit and VIX 2026-10-14 and the dollar index 2026-10-09, so the macro and volatility dimensions do not describe the day. In addition 6 of the 22 rows are the ETF's own move, where the equal-weight basket reading does not apply. US equities, themes, crypto and commodities are a 2026-10-15T19:37Z (about 15:37 ET) late-session snapshot, roughly 23 minutes before the 16:00 ET cash close, not closing values; A-share values are the day's close.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation sits at 0.625 with 5 of 8 production signals triggered (dollar strength, high real rates, small-cap underperformance, copper down, gold up); at a weight of 15 the dimension contributes 9.375 points, the model's largest single driver, carried at a 0.8 proxy discount.

High-yield OAS reads 3.25 at the 77.35 percentile with a risk score of 77.35, contributing 6.188 points at a weight of 10 as the second-largest pressure source; the newest print is already dated 2026-10-14.
The 10-year real rate is 2.88 at the 99.36 percentile with a risk score of 99.36, contributing 4.968 points; the reading is dated 2026-10-13.
The 10-year nominal yield is 5.21 at the 99.2 percentile with a risk score of 98.39, contributing 4.9195 points, likewise dated 2026-10-13.
The share of constituents above their 200-day average is 0.4516 with a risk score of 67.26, contributing 4.0941 points; a 0.0321 new-high ratio against a 0.1282 new-low ratio still reads weak.

supporting_signals.claim: The volatility dimension rose from 18.9 the previous session to 27.14, with the newest VIX print at 16.87 versus 15.27 before, a 1.6 increase; realized volatility at 9.6256 is still low, implying hedge demand rather than realized selling pressure.
The credit leg weakened alongside: high-yield OAS widened from 3.16 to 3.25 and investment-grade OAS edged from 0.83 to 0.84, lifting the liquidity and credit dimension from 63.15 to 65.28.
The AI hardware chain was the weakest link of the day: memory fell 3.9231, semiconductor_equipment fell 2.7256, networking fell 2.3462 and ai_infrastructure fell 1.9543.
The A-share memory and semiconductor sample closed sharply lower: 301308.SZ fell 6.143, 688525.SH fell 6.1891, 300475.SZ fell 7.6368, 688825.SH fell 5.2391 and 603986.SH fell 4.9016.
The US semiconductor sample was still mostly lower: NVDA fell 1.7307, AMD fell 0.808, AVGO fell 0.5762 and TSLA fell 1.2666, while MU rose 0.98 against a 10.885 one-week loss.

contradicting_signals.claim: The index level did not fall: the SPY proxy rose 0.3002 on the day and the spy_down signal did not trigger, so this is not a broad equity de-rating.
Of the 22 rows 12 rose and 10 fell, with a positive mean move of 0.4477, which does not support a broad risk-off reading at the theme level.
Crypto risk appetite is intact: the bitcoin_down signal did not trigger, with BTC at 82298.0 up 0.70198, ETH at 2449.72 up 0.85321 and SOL at 105.7 up 1.32247.
Credit has not entered stress: high-yield OAS at 3.25 is still below the 4.0 trigger so hy_oas_widening did not fire, and investment grade at 0.84 sits near its median.
The session-over-session move is in fact small: against 59.31 on 2026-10-14 the composite changed only -0.77, so the -2.84 trend_1d overstates the deterioration.

Vintages are not aligned: the rates leg is dated 2026-10-13, credit and VIX 2026-10-14, the dollar index 2026-10-09, core PCE 2026-08-01 and the Fed balance sheet 2026-10-07, while the equity leg is 2026-10-15T19:37Z.

The equity quotes are an intraday snapshot, not closing prices: 2026-10-15T19:37Z is about 15:37 ET, roughly 23 minutes before the 16:00 ET cash close, so any reading can still move materially into the close.

ETF proxy accounting: 6 of the 22 rows take the ETF's own move rather than the equal-weight basket, namely cloud_computing 1.2089, cybersecurity -0.6121, enterprise_software 1.5049, semiconductors -0.722, internet_platforms 0.8454 and gaming 2.2555.
Confidence at 0.9086 is high, but the weakest sub-factor is consistency at 0.683, well below data_quality at 1.0 and coverage at 0.93, making internal agreement the soft spot.

what_changed_today: The composite moved from 59.31 on 2026-10-14 to 58.54, -0.77 session-over-session; the same-calendar-day morning generation of 61.38 (high_risk) has been superseded.
Cross-asset confirmation retreated from the morning generation's 0.875 (7 of 8 triggered) to 0.625 (5 of 8 triggered).
The volatility dimension rose from 18.9 to 27.14 as the newest VIX print moved from 15.27 to 16.87.
High-yield OAS widened from 3.16 to 3.25 and investment grade from 0.83 to 0.84, lifting liquidity and credit from 63.15 to 65.28.
Equity structure eased from 66.6 to 64.41 and the share above the 200-day average at 0.4516 did not improve.
Technology split internally: 12 of 22 rows rose and 10 fell, with memory down 3.9231 against quantum_computing up 4.5002.
The A-share memory and semiconductor sample closed uniformly lower, with 301308.SZ down 6.143 and 300475.SZ down 7.6368, the deepest loss in the basket.
Reverse repo jumped from 0.201 to 1.201 on the 2026-10-15 print while the Fed balance sheet rose to 6747560.
TSM earnings came in at an actual 4.6 against a forecast of 4.45 and did not stop the selling in the hardware chain.
The inflation-hedge bid firmed: gold rose 1.8087 and silver rose 3.2763 while copper fell 0.9226 and WTI crude rose 1.2409.
watch_next: The FOMC meeting at 2026-10-28T18:00Z; FedWatch implies 4.105 for the 2026-12-16 meeting with an inferred hike.
PPI and Advance Retail Sales are dated 2026-10-15T12:30Z with no actual recorded in the fact layer, the next test of the inflation path.
The mega-cap earnings window: META and TSLA on 2026-10-21, MSFT and GOOGL on 2026-10-28, AMZN and INTC on 2026-10-29.
Whether the memory and semiconductor chain stops falling: memory fell 3.9231 on the day and NVDA at 217.470001 carries an RSI14 of 40.377, close to a weak-neutral reading.
Trend and breadth thresholds: price sits 6.5241 percentage points above the 200-day average, the 52-week drawdown is -0.9216 percentage points and 3-month momentum is 3.8504, with breadth at 0.4516.
Whether credit spreads keep widening: the gap between high-yield OAS at 3.25 and investment-grade OAS at 0.84 is the next thing to watch.
Whether the haven bid persists: gold and silver rose 1.8087 and 3.2763 on the day while copper fell 0.9226, suggesting the growth side is not strong.
Crypto risk appetite: BTC at 82298.0 rose 0.70198 with dominance at 0.593239, and a turn lower would re-trigger bitcoin_down.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the split narrows and the index level holds its gain
points: The index level did not fall: the SPY proxy rose 0.3002 and small-cap IWM rose 1.2898, implying money rotated inside technology rather than leaving equities.
Volatility is still low: realized volatility at 9.6256 and VIX at 16.87, up from 15.27 but far from a stress regime, leave the composite at 58.54 with room below the next band.
If the memory drawdown narrows, equity structure at 64.41 and cross-asset at 0.625 can both retreat quickly and the composite can fall back below 55.

base_case.title: Base case: the level stays at caution with the composite between 55 and 62
points: The published sequence runs 53.05 (2026-10-13) to 59.31 (2026-10-14) to 58.54, a band concentrated between 55 and 62.

The macro leg is lagged but unchanged in direction: the real rate at 2.88 sits at the 99.36 percentile and the 10-year nominal yield at 5.21 at the 99.2 percentile, making macro at 73.96 a rigid support.
The split inside technology likely persists: 12 of 22 rows up against 10 down, with a theme-level mean move of 0.4477 that is close to neutral.

bear_case.title: Bear case: hikes get priced in and the AI hardware selloff spreads to the index
points: FedWatch already implies 4.105 for the 2026-12-16 meeting with an inferred hike; a further hawkish FOMC on 2026-10-28 or PPI print would leave room for the real rate at 2.88 and the nominal yield at 5.21 to rise further.

The fading marginal benefit of memory pricing has been confirmed at the company level; if the 3.9231 decline in memory spreads beyond ai_infrastructure down 1.9543, the 0.3002 index-level gain becomes hard to hold.
If the credit leg keeps widening (high yield 3.25 against investment grade 0.84) and pushes cross-asset confirmation at 0.625 higher, the composite would spike again.
